title: An Act to Change the Appropriation for the Governor's Expense Account and Create Transparency in Expenditures Made from That Account

summary.text: This bill reduces the annual appropriation to the Governor's expense account to $30,000 and requires the Governor to provide a quarterly accounting of expenses made from the account and post that accounting on the Governor's publicly accessible website.
